title: Solar Service Visits: Route Confirmed Repair Completion Into O&M Billing
summary: Connect solar O&M visit evidence to coverage and billing review without assuming every completed visit is chargeable.
body_markdown:
## The operating decision


A solar O&M billing workflow should join the service visit, asset context, performed work, agreement coverage and customer evidence before finance receives the handoff. A technician's completed status does not establish that all work is chargeable. Separate included service, warranty questions, additional authorized repairs and follow-up recommendations. The workflow can assemble the packet and route unresolved items while qualified service staff and finance retain their respective decisions.


Explore the complete[solar installation and o&m services integration and automation hub](https://www.stacksync.com/industry/construction/solar-installation-service) for the systems and processes around this guide.
